Can I eat pizza tonight?
CHECKED 5 INGREDIENTS
Pizza is pretty manageable for you, the main thing to watch is just the cheese. Dairy is on your Limit list, so a normal pizza loaded with mozzarella is going to be a decent hit of it. If you keep the cheese light or do a white-pie-style slice with just a little, you're probably fine. A heavily cheesy deep dish or extra cheese order is where it starts to add up.

Everything else, the crust, tomato sauce, toppings like pepperoni, veggies, olives, is all good.

So go for it, just maybe don't do the extra cheese.

What should I order at an Italian restaurant?
BASED ON YOUR MAP
Italian is pretty friendly for you honestly. Grilled proteins like chicken, fish, or steak are great picks, and most pasta dishes are totally fine too since your only thing to watch is dairy. Tomato-based sauces like marinara or arrabbiata are a no-brainer. Salads, antipasto, bruschetta, roasted veggies, all good.

The ones to be a little careful with are cream-based pastas like alfredo or carbonara, and anything with a lot of cheese on top. A little parmesan is probably fine but a dish swimming in cream sauce is going to be a heavier dairy load. Same with anything like a four-cheese pasta or a cheesy baked dish.

Worth asking about sauces if you're not sure what's in them, since some can have cream added even when you don't expect it.
Safe picks: grilled fish or chicken, tomato-based pasta, salads, antipasto
Skip: alfredo, four-cheese dishes, heavy cream sauces
Ask about: sauces (hidden cream), baked dishes
